Route One Investment Company LP Increases Position in Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK); Jana Partners Increased Pinnacle Foods Del (PF) Stake
May 21, 2018 - By Peter Erickson
William Duhamel increased its stake in Liberty Global Plc (LBTYK) by 17.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Route One Investment Company Lp bought 410,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 7.44% with the market. The hedge fund run by William Duhamel held 2.69M shares of the television services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $91.15M, up from 2.28 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Route One Investment Company Lp who had been investing in Liberty Global Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $22.89B market cap company. The stock increased 0.42% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $28.46. About 3.92M shares traded or 22.43% up from the average. Liberty Global plc (NASDAQ:LBTYK) has declined 10.09% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 21.64% the S&P500.
Barry Rosenstein increased its stake in Pinnacle Foods Inc Del (PF) by 23.74% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jana Partners Llc bought 272,723 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.45% with the market. The hedge fund run by Barry Rosenstein held 1.42M shares of the consumer non-durables company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $84.54 million, up from 1.15M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jana Partners Llc who had been investing in Pinnacle Foods Inc Del for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.53 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.69% or $0.44 during the last trading session, reaching $63.21. About 1.05 million shares traded. Pinnacle Foods Inc. (NYSE:PF) has declined 6.35% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.90% the S&P500.
